objects.description: During [Juicy Mix](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0044), [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) used a Windows Credential Manager stealer for credential access.(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)
